name: ws-p4-86-panel-eth-2ro
title: Waveshare ESP32-P4-86-Panel-ETH-2RO
notes: ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-4B display module (ESP32-P4NRW32, 32 MB flash, 32 MB PSRAM; its ESP32-C6 unused) on the 86 Panel bottom board with the RJ45, two relays (GPIO32, 46) and RS485 (47, 48). Only this ETH-2RO version has Ethernet. IP101GRI with IDF's P4 defaults (MDC 31, MDIO 52, REF_CLK in on GPIO50), reset GPIO51, address 1. Pins: Waveshare wiki (ethernetbasic demo), Touch-LCD-4B and bottom board schematics. microSD on SDMMC slot 0 (CLK 43, CMD 44, D0-D3 39-42) on LDO channel 4; supply switch on GPIO45 on by default. The LCD isn't driven. Power LED only.
